consequence: Treat argument 2 as a number. Calling GetHealthDamage, GetShieldDamage, or GetOverguardDamage on it caused repeated live runtime errors.

consequence: SetBaseAmount is configured before victim resolution. Use the numeric SetDamageCallback result when an actual per-target result is required.

consequence: The approximation missed outer-ring ranged victims and appeared melee-only. Let Region:RadialDamage own selection.

consequence: Reacquire engine-owned state when needed; do not assume Lua wrapper identity persists across events.

consequence: Type it as the callback-local damaged AvatarOrEntity. V51 unwrapped 45 live values to two RifleLancerAvatar engine objects while the source ability identity stayed fixed.

hypothesis: SetOverguardAmount adds to the existing pool
consequence: It is used as an absolute setter. Read current value, compute the new absolute value, and pass only the positive delta to NotifyOverguardGain.

consequence: V52 proved callbackTarget:IsDead() resolves to nil on this exact wrapper and aborts afterDamage. Probe individual methods fail-open or use a separately proven native state boundary.

hypothesis: A lexical method name or behavior-family label proves the engine's gameplay semantics
consequence: Treat lexical families and names as discovery aids. Promote parameter meanings, effects, authority, and lifetime only from separate stock value flow, native binding, or live evidence.

hypothesis: An exact direct callsite list proves that every transitive helper behavior runs from an exported ability entry
consequence: Direct prototype membership is exact, but transitive execution requires a separately verified call graph and runtime conditions. Do not present direct calls as a complete execution trace.

hypothesis: A wrapper returned by DamageData:GetBaseAmount is an immutable numeric snapshot
consequence: Treat it as a borrowed packet-local live wrapper on the proven Ice Wave path. Copy GetModifiedValue to a Lua number before mutating the packet when the old value must be restored.

hypothesis: Repeated Lua userdata equality or a repeated native address proves one logical damage transaction
consequence: Key transaction state to the exact call boundary and target-local control flow. Engine allocator reuse can give consecutive logical objects the same printed address.

hypothesis: An exact luaCalls hook and nativeCalls hook observe identical nested execution boundaries
consequence: Choose the hook layer proven to observe the authoritative operation. Native callsite ownership does not imply that a nested Lua-entry callback fired.

hypothesis: The DE target-addon environment exposes every ordinary Luau math library field
consequence: Do not depend on an unproven standard-library member. Use compile-time numeric constants or probe and fail closed before gameplay mutation.

hypothesis: A one-times target may skip SetBaseAmount after another target used the same mutable packet boundary
consequence: Write the authoritative stock numeric value explicitly for every target, including multiplier one, then restore from a newly constructed wrapper after the synchronous native call.

hypothesis: The raw Efficiency unit upgrade factor is the final energy-cost factor for every ability
consequence: AlchemistDistill CrewShipInfo explicitly transforms the returned factor before calculating EnergyCost. Preserve the raw observation and distinguish initial casts, channels, Duration and path-specific caps.

hypothesis: A successful Avatar script blackboard query proves a complete list of active native buff contributors
consequence: Capture script-owned fields as observations. Keep total live stats separate from complete mod, shard and native Arcane attribution, which this table does not prove.

hypothesis: A returned HUD notification list is a complete decomposition of every active engine upgrade
consequence: Capture native HUD notifications as observed. Preserve Avatar rebuild-list versus HudStatus queue origins; hidden buffs, mods, shards and causal contributor decomposition remain unverified.

hypothesis: Every numeric HUD buff count is the number of native upgrade stacks
consequence: Preserve buffData/buffDataExtra and stock-confirmed HUD units. Do not derive upgrade stack count from percentages or generic numeric display data.

hypothesis: A successful GetBuffNotifications nil return means the getter failed
consequence: On the pinned executable nil is the empty-list result. Preserve GetterSucceeded, ReturnType and actual bounded GetterError separately; never relabel a thrown getter as an empty list.

consequence: Stock follows mMovie.GetInstigator to GetHudStatus; the contextual HudMovieInstigator role is not a native class name. Never substitute the caster inventory.

hypothesis: A fidelity rendering of an API-name hash as text proves literal string comparisons are correct in game
consequence: Audit constant tags at value uses. Name hashes and string literals sharing one upstream constant require separate emitted constants and remapped name/import uses.

consequence: Both startup/F9 and natural target activation must use the shared union; dropping diagnostics requests removes installed native observers.
